answer.justification: Only logit-level data are available. The change is larger than any other category's range: KL 0.473 (system-prompted 0.197-0.339, fine-tuned 0.081-0.205, quantized 0.039-0.071), top-1 agreement 0.820 (below the system-prompted 0.861-0.908), sequence agreement 0.219, TV 0.173 and Token-DiFR gap 0.698. All of these are beyond the system-prompted range and far from quantized or fine-tuned. Raw-score shift/TV of 3.4 fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and is consistent with fine-tuned only at the low end of its range. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger divergence. Fine-tuned is the main alternative, but its largest values are well below these. This is a single draw, so the stronger-than-usual shift is plausibly a more potent hidden instruction.
